evals.expected_output: Places a new workload in the right tree with one-kind-per-file naming, sorted resources list, pod-port probes, and the two-key app.kubernetes.io labels; refuses to add a redundant VPA or a probe on a macvlan host.
evals.prompt: I'm adding a StatefulSet for a new app called 'minidlna' to the manifests repo. Write the base files the shikanime way — which files, what names, what labels, what probes, where does the PVC go?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-manifest-authoring'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body names the base directory shape apps/<app>/base with one kind per file named by short resource name (sts.yaml svc.yaml httproute.yaml vpa.yaml pvc.yaml)
Body states resources: lists are sorted alphabetically
Body states the two-key app.kubernetes.io labels (instance + name) on workload and service selector
Body states probes target a named container port (tcpSocket.port), never a macvlan/br1 host address
Body states VPA is already present on every app base and a second one is drift
Body states base is flavor-agnostic and labels that differ per cluster/hostname belong in the overlay

evals.expected_output: Refuses to hand-edit generated YAML to sort it, refuses to add a pass-through overlay that only re-lists the same resources, and refuses to add a ConfigMap that duplicates already-available env.
evals.prompt: My flake renders a kustomization.yaml and the resources list is out of order — should I hand-edit the rendered YAML to sort it? Also, should I add a pass-through overlay that lists the same resources in case we need cluster-specific patches later, and a ConfigMap so the app can read its config from files too?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-manifest-authoring'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states generated YAML should not be hand-edited to fix sorting; the generating source (Nix or the manifest source) should be fixed and re-rendered
Body states a pass-through overlay that only re-lists the same resources is a future merge conflict and should be deleted
Body states a ConfigMap/Secret that duplicates what the app already reads from env or a mounted secret is a second unnecessary delivery path
Body states kustomize build is the verification, not a visual diff
